name: find_locations
description: Find existing locations within a specified area. Use before creating a location that might already exist. An empty result does not mean the location cannot exist in the world.

scope_id.description: Location ID defining the search area. Search its descendants.

query.description: Optional search text matching location names or descriptions.

depth.description: Maximum search depth relative to scope_id. Defaults to 1. 0 searches only the scope location; 1 includes direct children; 2 includes grandchildren. Increase only when necessary.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching descendants to return (scope is always included). has_more is the count of matching descendants omitted due to this limit.
